The changes in the header file ensure that the structure used throughout the driver reflects this new locking mechanism, while the changes in the implementation files ensure that all relevant functions utilize the mutex correctly. ```c
mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
```
```c
mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
```
```c
mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
```
Reason:
The bug is fixed by replacing spinlocks with mutexes, which are suitable for scenarios where operations can sleep. This change allows the thread to sleep without causing deadlocks, enabling proper handling of the operations without blocking other threads indefinitely.
